title: Bogong moths navigate with a light-dependent geomagnetic inclination compass
description:
Nature, Published online: 18 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11322-9

During their biannual migration, nocturnal Bogong moths (Agrotis infusa) rely on both a stellar and a geomagnetic compass for navigation, enabling them to maintain their migratory direction even if one of these cues is missing.
